messages.content: Extract barrier traversal only. Do not judge whether the scene is valid or physically possible. Return JSON only.

train door

RAW SCENE

Return UNSPECIFIED when RAW SCENE does not establish enough spatial information to tell. Do not infer validity from whether the barrier is open, closed, locked, broken, magical, or intact. Do not infer an unseen route. Return JSON: {"status":"..."}
